theorems.name: Submission.dohr_c1_uniform_first_order
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u U → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ closedBall x₀ η ⊆ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ closedBall x₀ η, ∀ y ∈ closedBall x₀ η, ‖u x - u y - fderiv ℝ u x₀ (x - y)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - y‖
